note: Player-level evidence for the team totals in external-cap-check.json, per team: the active table (cap hit, base, likely and unlikely incentives, guarantee, contract type), dead money, cap holds, and the page's own totals — `summary.apronTotal` is the apron tracker's figure and equals active + dead + unlikely + the 0/1-YOS minimum addback. Nothing in the app reads this; externalCapCheck.test.ts diffs against it. A name here we do not carry is a lead, not a verdict — Spotrac lags filings, their hold column keeps players who left the league years ago, and their 2026-27 column includes rows (non-guaranteed camp deals) we deliberately model differently.
